Get or set residue sequence number

Source: R/ke.R
coord_resseq.Rd

Get or set residue sequence number

Usage

coord_resseq(coord)

coord_resseq(coord) <- value

Arguments

coord

matrix or array with second dimension having columns 13 to 27 of the PDB ATOM records

value

integer or character vector with no more than four digits

Value

Getter: integer vector of residue sequence numbers. Setter: modified coord with updated residue sequence numbers.
